metadata.description: Small office network topology. Internet traffic enters via a router, passes through a firewall, and is distributed by a core switch. The switch connects wired devices (NAS, printer, VoIP phones) and an access point serving WiFi clients (laptops)

elements.name: Router
elements.description: Edge router. WAN uplink to ISP, LAN downlink to firewall

elements.name: Firewall
elements.description: Network firewall enforcing traffic policies between WAN and LAN

elements.name: Switch
elements.description: Core office switch. Distributes traffic to all wired devices and the access point

elements.name: Access Point
elements.description: Wireless access point providing WiFi connectivity to laptops

elements.name: NAS
elements.description: Shared file storage for the office, wired to the switch

elements.name: Printer
elements.description: Shared office printer, wired to the switch

elements.name: VoIP Phones
elements.description: Wired VoIP phones connected to the switch

elements.name: User Clients
elements.description: Employee laptops connecting wirelessly via the access point
